title: omp-private-relay config
description: $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/omp-private-relay/config.json (default ~/.config/omp-private-relay/config.json). Every key is optional except schemaVersion; environment variables named OMP_PRIVATE_RELAY_* override single keys (see the README). Secrets never go in this file.

bin.description: Absolute path of the omp binary that runs the relay and the web build. null: the omp found on PATH.

listen.description: Both listeners are bound to 127.0.0.1 and cannot be moved: the relay never listens on another interface.

guestPort.description: Where browsers connect: the web client and the guest sockets.

adapter.description: How a browser proves it may use the guest listener. token: loopback only, paired by a one-time link. tailscale-serve: reached through `tailscale serve`, which also has to name you as the owner.

allowedHosts.description: Extra lowercase host:port values accepted in the Host header, for an SSH port forward that uses a different local port. 127.0.0.1:<guestPort> and localhost:<guestPort> are always accepted.

bin.description: The tailscale command, by name or absolute path.

servePort.description: The https port `tailscale serve` listens on. Default: the guest port.

owner.description: Tailscale login of the owner. Empty: read from `tailscale status` and refreshed every minute.

publicHost.description: MagicDNS name of this machine. Empty: read from `tailscale status`.

mode.description: own: the relay keeps the pairing store and can redeem pairing links itself. shared: another program (a dashboard) writes the store and the relay only reads it.

cookieName.description: Name of the browser cookie that holds the session id. In shared mode it must match the program that sets it.

dir.description: Directory the web client is served from. Default: <data dir>/web/current.

checkDir.description: Directory for the listener check key (relay-check/1). Default: <config dir>/check.

maxConnections.description: WebSockets open or being upgraded, on both listeners. The next upgrade is refused with HTTP 503 before a socket exists. Plain HTTP connections are not counted.

maxHostFrame.description: Bytes. Largest frame an omp host may send.

maxGuestFrame.description: Bytes. Largest frame a browser may send.

connQueueMax.description: Bytes queued for one connection before it is cut with 4008.

relayQueueMax.description: Bytes queued across all connections before slow ones are cut.

recheckMs.description: How often open browsers are checked against the pairing store. At most 30 s.

restartGraceMs.description: After a start, a browser asking for a room whose host has not reconnected yet is told to retry (4001) instead of that the room does not exist (4004).
